title: WillScot Announces Investor Conference Schedule for September 2026
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about WillScot Holdings Corporation's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://investors.willscot.com/node/21566/pdf)


SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- WillScot Holdings Corporation (“WillScot” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: WSC), a leader in innovative temporary flexible space solutions, today announced that it will participate in the following investor conferences over the upcoming weeks:


- **D.A. Davidson Diversified Industrials & Services Conference** Date: September 24, 2026
Location: Nashville, Tennessee


- **Deutsche Bank Leveraged Finance Conference** Date: September 29, 2026
Location: Scottsdale, Arizona


Portfolio managers and analysts who wish to request a meeting should contact their sales representative at the sponsoring firms.


**About WillScot**


WillScot (Nasdaq: WSC) is a leading provider of innovative turnkey space solutions in North America, helping customers keep projects moving and operations running. The Company partners with critical industries including construction, manufacturing, healthcare, government, energy and education to deliver the right solutions coupled with a high level of customer service. WillScot’s comprehensive portfolio of products – including modular complexes, dry and cold storage containers, blast-resistant buildings, clearspan industrial structures, fencing, and add-on furnishings and equipment – is customizable and flexible to support any project need. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Ariz., WillScot operates from a network of approximately 240 branch locations in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico.


Additional information can be found on the company's website at[www.willscot.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=p3hKcK36PxVpDmc-8q_gbrNw1f16Jg6BmMn3whn7VFwZYlblwXAooK8vRWh31oUt0f2dhu7iDIq_UMj3ZQH0k17KvT2lxmYOt25V8d0wqwM=) .
